title: 探究大语言模型在静力学问题上的解题能力
summary: 本研究通过模型蒸馏方法评估LLM解决静力学问题的能力。实验表明，LLM在纯文本问题上表现良好，但引入图表和多步推理后准确率下降。性能下降主要源于多步推理困难，而非图像识别限制。
summary_en: This study evaluates LLM capability on statics problems via model distillation. Results show good performance on text-only problems but accuracy drops with diagrams and multi-step reasoning, primarily due to reasoning difficulties rather than image recognition limits.
